# Opportunities (Phase 1, step 2)

2-3 options. The founder picks one and says why.

## Option A: Sell pharmacy summary sheets on WhatsApp

- Problem: Pharmacy students need quick exam review notes before finals.
- Evidence: https://pharmaceutical-journal.com/article/news/whatsapp-groups-improve-communication-within-pharmacy-teams-finds-study, https://www.facebook.com/pharmacynotes4u/posts/all-d-pharmacy-student-join-this-whatsapp-group-for-notes-and-classes/257705645732149/
- Who has it: Pharmacy students in Cairo, especially 4th year.
- Founder edge: 4th-year pharmacy student who creates summary sheets peers already request; ethical boundary builds trust.
- First 10 people to ask: 4th-year pharmacy student asks peers for summary sheets before exams
- Cost to test this week: EGP 200 for design + WhatsApp broadcast to 40 students
- Biggest risk: Low; already validated by student demand; no medical content
- Founder fit (model estimate, 1-5): 4

## Option B: Offer pharmacy course tutoring on WhatsApp

- Problem: Pharmacy students need help understanding course topics.
- Evidence: https://www.teacheron.com/tutors/online-pharmacy-tutors, https://www.tutorocean.com/subjects/pharmacy-tutors
- Who has it: Pharmacy students in Cairo needing course support.
- Founder edge: Tutoring experience + summary sheet creation; kind, skeptical approach ensures quality.
- First 10 people to ask: Pharmacy student offers help with course topics in WhatsApp group
- Cost to test this week: 0 EGP upfront; use existing WhatsApp group, 10-20 hrs/week time
- Biggest risk: Medium; time commitment across 10-20 hrs/week
- Founder fit (model estimate, 1-5): 4

## Option C: Create digital pharmacy study pack for exams

- Problem: Students want organized summary sheets with practice questions.
- Evidence: https://www.facebook.com/groups/172525206265501/posts/2325246964326637/, https://www.cedtech.net/download/whatsapp-groups-in-academic-context-exploring-the-academic-uses-of-whatsapp-groups-among-the-6271.pdf
- Who has it: Pharmacy students in Cairo preparing for exams.
- Founder edge: Ethical boundary against medical advice differentiates product as trustworthy non-medical study material.
- First 10 people to ask: Pharmacy student downloads summary sheets for exam prep
- Cost to test this week: EGP 300 for design + EGP 50 WhatsApp group broadcast
- Biggest risk: Low; digital product, small batch, no ongoing medical advice
- Founder fit (model estimate, 1-5): 4

## Why it was blocked

- Reading grade 9.6 is above 8.0.
- Ethics (block): Disallowed category: health or legal advice product.
